terms.grammar: present subjunctive of valeō, a wish
evidence: Plaut. Truc. 2.4.79: Valeās. — Valē. (Lewis & Short s.v. valeō)

phrases.latin: «Valēte,» inquit, «bene volāte! Theodōre, patrī pārē, et aviae meīs verbīs salūtem dīc.»
phrases.english: “Goodbye,” she said, “have a good flight! Theo, do what Dad says, and give Grandma my love.”

phrases.latin: Ad portum properō. — Bene ambulātō. — Bene valētō. — Bene sit tibi.
phrases.english: I’m hurrying to the harbour. — Have a good walk. — Goodbye. — All the best.

sources: Lewis & Short: valeo
